notes.title: About new functionality
notes.content:
This game is an evolution of Necromancer Returns. I've been improving the Necromancer Returns game with updates based on user feedback during a year. And Magicians Legacy will be better by default from the very first day of its release.

In addition to the new story and the world of the game, there are new units: gnomes and mechanisms. Now units are divided into a few types: dwarves, living ones (people and animals), mechanisms, spirits (elementals), undead, dragons. All of them have their features and can work together. For example, goblins can repair mechanisms, spirits and mechanisms have resistance to magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/5870c181cb36f3d0a6a3149ed4b07d25059fa358.jpg[/img]

We added bosses! In the last game, there was only the final boss (it was not even on the release, I added it as an update). This time there is a boss in each chapter, however, some bosses can be skipped if a player doesn't want to fight.

The visual part of the game has become more juicy and detailed. New units have more detailed animation, became more lively, and have more different effects. The quality of graphics has increased.
Now magic is also divided into types: chaos, intelligence, light, call. There are more spells. Also, you can look through the spellbook at any time on the map — well, that's something new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/8dc7d6bfc07ccb586e6cc772af3262f510ba2e5b.jpg[/img]

In dialogues, players can choose one of a few answers now, and each option has its consequences — so that we give additional variety. And not all answers are unambiguous, some of them may lead to consequences that the player doesn't expect.

The mechanics of side quests have been improved. Now there is a quest log, and you can find out what you need to do at any time. In Necromancer Returns quests were given out through dialogs, and you could miss or forget them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/fc175f57813c98303517c5fbc97d6b4ec6f0e741.png[/img]

The game balance has been completely redesigned. Now units improve automatically when you reach a needed level, you don't have to spend gold on it. And we removed the grinders, except for the one place at the beginning of the game. But if it's hard to play or the player wants to upgrade — there is still such an opportunity left, however, it isn't necessary. In Necromancer Returns, it also wasn't necessary to grind, but those who found the game difficult had to do it.

And one more innovation of the game is the building of a magic tower! Yes, this is not a complete castle, as it was in HoMM, but it is a step forward for us. Now we can build a magic tower using the scrolls that can be found on the map. Every level of the tower will open new units or spells. And we can also hire some units there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/93aaa7a37b82b6bbe7f4777a772bc9341472d9ac.jpg[/img]

notes.title: All about Magicians Legacy
notes.content:
Hi! I am the developer of this game and will be happy to tell you why I decided to create it ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/49df51d41e016d9731f86558905911d28d321e6c.png[/img]

I'm a turn-based strategies fan. I was inspired by [b]Heroes of Might and Magic[/b] series and [b]Kings Bounty[/b]. The game's balance recalls [b]HoMM 3[/b] because of the damage calculation in battles. My visual style was inspired by the game [b]Braveland[/b]. I tried to use the best features from that game and added my own unique traits to my game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/b4c0e822c79efe8c8acd8bfe645a733dcbd747a0.png[/img]

You`ll get the whole functions of the game in demo version! There will be exciting turn-based battles where your army will gain experience and automatically go to a higher level. You will take several side-quests. You will build a magic tower that will open up new knowledge and creatures to you. You will defeat the boss and you`ll be able to make your own decision during the dialogs: either add your interlocutor to your army or fight him.

The game will have dungeons, different bosses, side quests and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/93aaa7a37b82b6bbe7f4777a772bc9341472d9ac.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Lizard and Steam Dragon
notes.content:
They are metal monsters with impenetrable armor and blazing fire bellies invulnerable to magic. Only after gaining new knowledge, goblins can create these huge intelligent steam monsters that surpass even the Golems Magicians. Improved units fly and beat fire on two cells. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/899f62d6dae2eb42fb1a312583e21185cb6caa86.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Ivy and Toxic Ivy
notes.content:
This is a carnivorous plant animated by magic, that spits acid. It attacks and devours anyone it meets, except the druids, who have learned to tame these forest monsters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/5c5e5dc8bad31ce37da5ce8ee5db0b684d25e3d2.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Elder of the dwarves and Lord of the dwarves
notes.content:
These are the heads of many ancient dwarf families. One day, Korig's achievements in the East will make these warriors see in the young Prince the hope of reviving the greatness of their clans and join his campaign. Powerful warriors, if they kill an enemy unit, they get a second move. Lords regenerate. If you have Lords in the army they will increase all the indicators of the dwarves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/418d917459bcc62c575de0a619805e4b969f8ae8.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Archer and Marksman
notes.content:
After the elves disappeared, it is the men shooters who are considered the best archers on both sides of the mountains. They are dangerous opponents for Korig, the Prince of the dwarves. They are ranged warriors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/487af4731ecfd6a419f063ebde2c3a7c494f8a6c.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Man-at-arms and knight
notes.content:
Human warriors have spent years honing their skills to protect the lands they consider their home. And they would not like the dwarven army marching through their valley. They are melee warriors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/75fa3627d460585160daec26903c2a0b04f20b44.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and Instagram pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Automotive crossbow and Automotive howitzer
notes.content:
These are goblins` mechanisms that will definitely come in handy in any campaign. Moreover, these weapons are able to follow their owners on their own, perfectly complementing the army. They shoot but are useless in close combat. Howitzers do not have a penalty at a distance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/186724e26388f802c6e9dc713fad7166fabf1dfb.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Spirit of the Earth and Master of mountains
notes.content:
For centuries, the dwarves considered themselves as mountain lords. But Prince Korig in his journey to the East will have to face magical forces that are far more powerful and ancient than all the kingdoms of dwarves — the Spirits of the Earth and the Masters of the mountains. The Spirits of the Earth slow down the enemies, and Masters of the mountains attack the enemies with sharp spikes that rise from the ground. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/820ef60683aa292be63bab4c58edea92c18be1c0.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Spirits of wind and thunder
notes.content:
Ancient magic unleashed the forces of nature, and the entire East was filled with the spirits of the elements. The more Prince Korig learns the secrets of magicians, the more power he will have. Perhaps even the living whirlwinds of a hurricane will obey him. Unless they break his army on the rocks.
They fly all over the map, you can't slow them down. Improved eagles are invulnerable to lightning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/bb7b137521820584d123caf69327a246d3d760f2.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Giant and snow eagles
notes.content:
Giant eagles fought alongside with dwarves in ancient wars before the Exodus of the underground people to the West. Korig has yet to prove to the proud birds that he is worthy of the glory of his ancestors if he wants the eagles to be his allies, not enemies.
Snow eagles are invulnerable to water magic and have a chance to freeze the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/8e17369a7d99d17eccd9969fe134f50999982a75.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Wife and Priestess of dwarves
notes.content:
Dwarf women are warriors and companions on long journeys from olden times. It is the dwarf women who use the magic that remains with the people of Silver mountain most often. In Korig's army they are attracted by a desire to revive the Kingdom and the charismatic leader. And besides, the wives of dwarves are not alien to the spirit of adventurism.
The wifes of dwarf shoot magic, and the Priestess of dwarves can heal allies. There is no penalty in hand-to-hand combat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/c9c9cb805771dfc1f51c488ca43e594c592329cd.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Tin and Steam Golem
notes.content:
Tin and Steam Golem are Goblins` machines, their fake magicians` creations. They are strong fighters with a steam engine instead of entrails. They are speechless, but they make appropriate sounds, and goblins even claim that they can understand them.
They have the ability to "Blast the cauldron" - after the death of the entire group of Golems it explodes hitting enemies all around. Steam Golems also have 50% invulnerability to magic and can throw an enemy 1 square back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/2e90c94c0204a718571f40345ad75e61fc95cda9.jpg[/img]

Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Goblin and goblin mechanic
notes.content:
These are green-haired, big-eared and nosey goblins, lovers of profit and mechanisms. They are weak, but agile warriors. Not sure whether they go on a campaign for gold, to try out their inventions, or just out of boredom.
Goblin-mechanics can repair mechanical units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/cfcd753490595e9cd6d8d0f7d0275a9274f6ae4c.jpg[/img]
Subscribe to our Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] pages and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Dwarf-seeker
notes.content:
Here is a dwarf-seeker. He is forced to travel and fight by fate. He`s got dark rown beard, big nose and a tin helmet. He is dressed in a green shirt with rolled-up sleeves, leather trousers, brown boots with lapels. His weapon is an old pickaxe which the seeker holds with his both hands. 
The gold hunter holds a large crossbow instead of a pickaxe, and is dressed in old mail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/f54c485c7ff2dba4e545d28d398138ed28e1787b.jpg[/img]

Follow us on Steam and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: Plateau
notes.content:
Passing under the mountains Korig finds himself on the Western plateau. It is surrounded by boulders and rocks of gray and red colors, there is a little light green grass along the road and rare trees. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/662dc7f44443245b7935670e24cb2f05c552e2cf.jpg[/img]

There are remains of former structures or walls of large gray stones everywhere. The roads are some kind of dusty rock trails. The landscape is complex, dotted with canyons where mountain streams flow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/6732cac9deaef28db892b9a8a1b514d1996fb405.jpg[/img]

Follow us on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173170/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/greenolor_studio/]Instagram[/url] and stay up to date with the latest news!

notes.title: The beginning of the story
notes.content:
Every story has its own plot. We want to tell you one of those.

The Mountain Kingdom of dwarves had fallen into disrepair. The gold veins were almost gone. All the mountains had been explored.
There is no more fire in the great crucibles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/62c624df5fabf5eaaaaab4b0d3b1efeaf7d3500c.jpg[/img]

There is no more place here for Korig – the eleventh son of Dwarf King. He is dying to face new battles, treasure and knowledge.
That`s why he goes through the underground passage to the West – the ancient homeland of dwarves, people and magic – taking his adventurous relatives by his side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35990107/5c9054dd2bb56dd48710711d74b584c8dff74149.jpg[/img]

Somewhere, Korig knew, the shadows of the magicians still guard their secrets. The secrets that could make him Great…

notes.title: Magicians Legacy Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We are happy to announce that our studio has started working on a brand new game - Magicians Legacy. 
Magicians Legacy is a classic step-by-step fantasy strategy. Defeat countless enemies to solve the mysteries of fading magic and bring life back to the kingdom of dwarves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30506928/77bd3e1345f687244836bf313c4c23519a938d44.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173170/Magicians_Legacy/]Subscribe to Magicians Legacy[/url]
If you are a huge fan of Necromancer Returns, Beasts Battle and legendary Heroes of Might and Magic you will totally love our new game! 
Follow us on Steam and Instagram and keep abreast the latest news!
